name: m2734-bread
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, 7th-century Arabia, bright warm daylight. Close shot of one anonymous RIGHT hand tearing a piece from a round golden flat bread over a woven palm-leaf mat, a few crumbs falling, a wooden bowl of dates beside it. Only the right hand and forearm in a plain undyed period sleeve are visible - no face, no head, no left hand. Exactly five fingers, natural proportions. Background softly blurred: a sunlit mud-brick wall and green date palms. Vibrant warm colours, no modern objects.
